svg.title: The mokume pipeline
svg.desc: Overview of the mokume proteomics pipeline: source spectra and a sequence database are quantified into a protein-by-sample matrix, then normalized, imputed, batch-corrected and tested for differential expression. Each stage lists its best-known methods.
